text:
emma: Heads up — a candidate flagged that the interview guide attached to calendar invites is rendering fields out of order and the 'culture-fit' section is missing. Happens for iOS and Gmail web. 😬

emma: Here's the payload we send to the printing/template service: `{"candidate_id": 4321, "template": "interview_guide_v3", "answers": [...], "scorecard": ["skills","culture-fit","role-fit"]}`

emma: The PDF that gets produced lists `role-fit` first, then `skills`, and omits `culture-fit`. Not a small edge-case — scheduling for 12 candidates today used these PDFs.

dana: Ugh. Are we sure it's the rendering service and not an ATS export? Any recent changes to templates?

emma: I pulled the exact webhook payload from the ATS and confirmed the array order is correct. So ATS -> webhook looks fine. The mismatch must be downstream.

raj: tagging myself. I pushed a change last week to the templating lib to de-duplicate repeated keys (we got a bug where arrays with identical entries collapsed). Could be that regression.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment job #deploy-1834 completed to staging at 2025-11-20T15:02:00Z (raj).

hiring-tools-svc: automated: Received webhook for candidate 4321 at 2025-11-20T15:05:12Z. Template=interview_guide_v3. Environment=prod.

raj: Repro steps I need: exact webhook JSON (full), and a failing rendered PDF (attach or link to S3). If you can paste the content around the scorecard array I can run a local render.

emma: Repro steps: 1) Create interview on ATS with template v3 2) Add scorecard fields in this order: skills, culture-fit, role-fit 3) Trigger invite send. Attached is the PDF output (s3://redwood-dev-bucket/tmp/4321-guide.pdf). I also pasted the webhook below: ```json
{"candidate_id":4321,"template":"interview_guide_v3","scorecard":["skills","culture-fit","role-fit"],"scheduled_at":"2025-11-21T10:00:00Z"}
```

dana: Impact: 12 candidates today, 2 panels already started using the wrong guide. Can we pause auto-send of attachments until we know root cause?

raj: Agreed pause makes sense. I can toggle the `attach_pdf` flag off in prod for invites to be safe. Will do a canary hotfix to revert the de-dup patch if needed.

emma: Please 👍 — blocking scheduling for new invites would help. I'll message the sourcers to hold off.

raj: Quick patch plan: 1) Disable attach_pdf for the next 30m 2) Roll canary with older templating lib (pre-de-dup change) to the render worker 3) Re-render sample/verify 4) If good, promote.

lili: ops oncall: I've disabled `attach_pdf` for invites (flag flipped) and notified calendar sync. Also created an incident ticket: INC-2025-114. Setting watchers: dana, emma, raj.

dana: I'll smoke test with 3 sample candidates once the canary is up. Please ping me when ready.

raj: Canary started on render-worker-canary-2. I ran the local render against the provided payload and the PDF includes `culture-fit` in the right position now.

raj: Rolling to 10% of workers, monitoring. Keeping `attach_pdf` off until we see stable renders on production samples.

hiring-tools-svc: automated: re-render job queued for candidate 4321 on canary worker.

dana: Smoke test pass for sample A/B/C. Ordering and fields correct. I'll call this verified from recruiting ops side.

emma: Thank you!! Can we add an automated test that verifies array order for scorecard fields so this doesn't regress?

raj: Yes — adding unit test for array-preserve ordering + an integration test for the render worker. Will add to PR and link.

emma: Awesome. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :raised_hands:

lili: Incident INC-2025-114 updated: root cause suspected templating lib dedupe behavior; mitigation applied (flag + canary); follow-up: add tests + revert patch or patch to preserve order.
